checked_requirements.evidence: All three requested result summaries identify output and interpretation. Profile decision fields feed the comparison result; illustrative examples remain labeled.
Trivy supplies an image command with explicit scanner, digest placeholder, registry/engine/archive assumptions and package-match limits.

Six pilot profiles provide prerequisites, input, action, expected signal, correction and adaptation. Their execution labels remain illustrative; CBMC harness/bounds and detect-secrets synthetic/baseline semantics are explicit.

Pinned Ruff/mypy reruns match the retained evidence and current input digests. Shared run record separates plan, observation, status and gate; cancelled/skipped/incomplete states and illustrative unexecuted material remain distinct.
Decision record includes component/connection, edition/workflow, rationale, prerequisites, unknowns and evidence. It links to run records after evaluation without changing exported system data.
The two authored relationships are shared through toolChoices with profile links and comparison summaries, point to one longer explanation, and avoid diagnostic-count rankings.
Triage and CI guides share states and run records, distinguish findings from failed/incomplete runs, retain failure artifacts, and label provider CI setup illustrative.
Static primer links configuration checks, Hadolint, Checkov/Trivy and detect-secrets; distinguishes deployed behavior, secret validity, history and remediation.

One bounds-check illustration differentiates abstract values/alarms, symbolic conditions and generated inputs, proof obligations, and modeled data-flow paths. Required profile backlinks and Eva/WP primary references are present.

Task route: orientation -> catalog/source-language guidance -> profile -> Python recipe -> run record -> triage. Learning route: orientation -> static approaches -> configuration/Hadolint or advanced methods. Browser rendering remains coordinator scope.
Primary docs support separate rule/database retrieval, metrics, reports, runner location and managed execution. Offline preparation/freshness limits and untested network behavior remain explicit.
